foundry_calls.text: A drip of water counts the silence. The crypt waits with the patience of the dead.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: The dripping stops. In the new quiet you hear it: a faint scrape of stone on stone from beyond the northern archway.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage
